$docPath = (Get-ChildItem "G:\0.0.0.Dashboard\IMPORT - C*U H?I\trong\Import-CH*.doc" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
Write-Host "File: $docPath"
$word = New-Object -ComObject Word.Application
$word.Visible = $false
$doc = $word.Documents.Open($docPath)
$table = $doc.Tables(1)
Write-Host "Total rows: $($table.Rows.Count)"
$eCount = 0
$fCount = 0
for ($i = 1; $i -le $table.Rows.Count; $i++) {
    $cellText = $table.Cell($i, 1).Range.Text.Trim()
    $cellText = $cellText -replace "`r|`a|`7", ""
    if ($cellText -eq "E") { $eCount++ }
    if ($cellText -eq "F") { $fCount++ }
}
Write-Host "Rows with E: $eCount"
Write-Host "Rows with F: $fCount"
$doc.Close($false)
$word.Quit()
[System.Runtime.Interopservices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($word) | Out-Null

Đã xác nhận 100 dòng E và 100 dòng F. Đang xóa từ dưới lên để tránh lệch chỉ số.

[REDACTED]

input.command:
$docPath = (Get-ChildItem "G:\0.0.0.Dashboard\IMPORT - C*U H?I\trong\Import-CH*.doc" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
Write-Host "Processing: $docPath"

$word = New-Object -ComObject Word.Application
$word.Visible = $false
$doc = $word.Documents.Open($docPath)
$table = $doc.Tables(1)

$deletedE = 0
$deletedF = 0
$rowsToDelete = @()

for ($i = 1; $i -le $table.Rows.Count; $i++) {
    $cellText = $table.Cell($i, 1).Range.Text.Trim()
    $cellText = $cellText -replace "`r|`a|`7", ""
    if ($cellText -eq "E" -or $cellText -eq "F") {
        $rowsToDelete += $i
    }
}

Write-Host "Found $($rowsToDelete.Count) rows to delete"

# Delete from bottom to top
for ($j = $rowsToDelete.Count - 1; $j -ge 0; $j--) {
    $rowIndex = $rowsToDelete[$j]
    $cellText = $table.Cell($rowIndex, 1).Range.Text.Trim() -replace "`r|`a|`7", ""
    $table.Rows($rowIndex).Delete()
    if ($cellText -eq "E") { $deletedE++ }
    if ($cellText -eq "F") { $deletedF++ }
}

Write-Host "Deleted E rows: $deletedE"
Write-Host "Deleted F rows: $deletedF"
Write-Host "Remaining rows: $($table.Rows.Count)"

$doc.Save()
$doc.Close($false)
$word.Quit()
[System.Runtime.Interopservices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($word) | Out-Null
Write-Host "Done - file saved."
